name: stroke-draw-text
title: Stroke Draw Text
description: An SVG path rendition of the headline whose strokes draw themselves via stroke-dashoffset on entering view; the DOM text stays present for accessibility while the drawn paths carry the visual.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
